title: LA County Arts Internship Program (college students)
org: LA County Department of Arts and Culture
summary: Internships for undergraduate students at nonprofit performing, presenting, film, media and literary arts organizations. Interns can work between June 1, 2026 and March 1, 2027, depending on the organization. Each organization sets its own dates, hours and on-site or remote arrangements.
note: Remote or on-site depends on the host organization.
eligibility: Undergraduate students (per the source); residency rules are not shown here.
